title: deployment.rollback reaches the shared runtime contract and all four digest mirrors
description:
SPIDR prerequisite of task-95e68a8dd2464e7b8ad4b1f8c4d2b2e4, cut by architect-b63fabf3 on 2026-09-05 on the INTERFACE axis. That row asked for scheduled backups, a NEW human-only command kind with "the full roster backfill and a bidirectional set-equality roster test", AND the rollback effect - three deliverables of which the middle one is, on this board, a measured multi-row job on its own.

MEASURED AT HEAD f3b94eaa (branch moe/work-2026-09-04) by architect-b63fabf3:
- `git grep -c "deployment\.rollback" -- apps packages` = ZERO. Brand new kind, nothing to duplicate.
- `deployment.deploy` and `deployment.set_target` ARE already on the roster (runtime-vocabulary.ts:91), landed by task-04b3ce7e's contract half - so this row follows a trail its sibling just cut, and should read that row's completionSummary before starting.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the string `deployment.rollback` published on RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS, the hand-transcribed EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS and size literal in runtime-contract.test.ts moved with it, the client REGENERATED, and all four GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST mirrors rotated. Six files, no more.

WHY THIS IS ITS OWN ROW AND NOT A CLAUSE: adding ANY kind to RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS rotates the contract digest by construction - contract-digest.ts puts `commandKinds: sortedCopy(RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS)` inside canonicalContractSurface(), which deriveContractDigest() SHA256s. There are FOUR mirrors and two of them live under apps/control-room, invisible to `pnpm test` (the root vitest include has no apps/**), `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`. A forgotten mirror ships two hard-throwing tests behind three green gates. That trap has already blocked one row on this board.

CENSUS THE MIRRORS YOURSELF with a full-tree `git grep` of the digest literal across ALL file types - the set has moved twice and a `--include=*.ts` grep misses the .tsx one.

NOT IN SCOPE: the daemon vocabulary, families, registry, roster tests, the MCP fence and HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS - all the successor row. The backups and the rollback effect - task-95e68a8d and its successor.

VERIFY: `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` (the only leg that sees mirrors 3 and 4); also run `pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test`, `pnpm typecheck` and root `pnpm test`, quoting every count line.
definitionOfDone: `deployment.rollback` is a member of RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS in packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts in SORTED position, and packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-contract.test.ts agrees in BOTH coupled assertions: the hand-transcribed EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS list and the `commands.size` literal. Do NOT derive the expected list from the tuple - that file's own comment forbids it and a derived list asserts nothing. Do NOT freeze the count from this description: run the leg and reconcile against the PRINTED expected/received, because sibling rows move the same literal.

The generated client was REGENERATED, never hand-edited - `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate` - with the OLD and NEW GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST both quoted in the completion record. An UNCHANGED digest means the generator did not see the new kind: that is a stop, not a pass. contract-digest.test.ts DERIVES the digest rather than pinning it, so it must go green WITHOUT being edited.

The mirror set was CENSUSED rather than quoted from this row: `git grep -n <old digest> -- . ':!.moe' ':!pnpm-lock.yaml'` run BEFORE the change (expect four hits) and AFTER (expect zero), across ALL file types. Every hit carries the new hex, including GENERATED_FILE_SHA256 beside CONTRACT_DIGEST in generated-coverage.test.ts. A fifth hit, or a hit in a file type a *.ts grep would miss, is a stop-and-report.

MUTATION DRILL, quoted with its failing line: revert ONLY the apps/control-room mirror and confirm `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` goes RED with the compat gate's own refusal message. That drill is this row's most valuable artifact - it is the only proof the two apps/control-room mirrors are covered by any gate at all.

Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` (MANDATORY), `pnpm typecheck`, and root `pnpm test` - stating plainly that the root lane covers NO apps/** file.
The diff touches exactly six files and no seventh, and ZERO files under apps/daemon/. Prove it with `git status --porcelain -- apps/ packages/` in the completion record.
taskRails: CONTRACT SURFACE ONLY. This row publishes a string on a roster and carries through the digest consequences. It wires no daemon command, defines no refusal code, fences no principal and renders no UI.
NEVER hand-edit the generated client. It is generator output; the only legal way to change it is `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate`.
THE DIGEST MIRROR SET MOVES. Census it with a full-tree `git grep` of the LITERAL across all file types before trusting any list, including this row's.
`pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` IS MANDATORY: two mirrors live under apps/control-room and no other gate sees them.
